intro: Lesson 10: When and where was ancient Greece?. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Where was it?
points: Cities round the Mediterranean and Black Sea

parts.text: Years from 508 BC to AD 1: about 508

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: About 2,535 years ago (ignoring that there is no year 0)

keywords.def: from a very long time ago
a large, organised society with towns, laws and writing
a city that ruled itself and the land around it

questions.q: How long ago was the first recorded Olympics?
Put in order: 146 BC, 776 BC, 490 BC.
Core: Make a timeline from 800 BC to AD 100 and add the five Greek events plus the Roman invasion of Britain (AD 43).
questions.a: Six events in the right places

questions.q: Extend: Work out how long ago two events happened.
questions.a: For example: 490 BC is about 2,517 years ago

questions.q: Stretch: Was ancient Greece before or after Stonehenge's big stones (about 2500 BC)? By how much?
questions.a: After: about 1,700 years later than 2500 BC compared with 776 BC
B) 508 BC. With BC, the bigger number is further back in time.

questions.q: Big question: how can ancient Greece still affect your life?
questions.a: Ideas like democracy, the Olympics, maths and buildings still shape life today
